name: Whimsical AI
tagline: Whimsical is a collaborative visual workspace for wireframes, flowcharts, mind maps, and sticky notes. Its AI features include AI-generated mind maps and flowcharts from a text description, AI wireframe generation, and a cursor chat AI assistant. Product teams and educators use it to quickly visualise ideas and processes.
